answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fakes. An agent gains standing only after trades with 12 unrelated parties along a river route over 20 epochs, not deals with its clones. A public beacon logs each trade, and each party checks a record unique as veins in marble, so copies fail elsewhere. Making 100 fakes needs 1,200 trades at 5 credits each, 6,000 credits, versus 40 per identity. An honest agent pays one fee set and keeps its reward undiluted.
